Position Summary
The Quality Control Inspector is responsible for inspecting, testing, and verifying

company procedures. This position works closely with Production, Engineering, and
Quality personnel to identify defects, prevent quality issues, and support continuous

compliance with established standards.

with company procedures.

root causes.

 Assist with maintaining and updating inspection procedures, forms, and quality
documentation.
 Calibrate and maintain inspection equipment as required.
 Ensure measuring and test equipment is properly identified and within calibration
requirements.
 Participate in internal audits, process audits, and continuous improvement
activities.
 Monitor production processes for adherence to established quality requirements.
 Provide feedback to production personnel regarding quality issues and inspection
findings.
 Maintain a clean, organized, and safe inspection/work area.

 Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory
requirements.

Qualifications

fabrication, or a related field preferred.

 Working knowledge of dimensional tolerances and basic inspection techniques.
 Ability to use precision measuring instruments.
 Basic computer skills and ability to accurately enter and maintain quality data.
 Strong attention to detail and ability to identify defects or deviations from

quality procedures.

Testing & Quality Control:

  • Perform functional testing on finished assemblies using testing equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.).

  • Inspect wiring installations, assemblies, and circuits for resistance factors and operational defects.

  • Troubleshoot errors and repair or replace defective parts to meet quality standards.

Maintenance & Safety:

  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace (5S methodology).
